title: Authenticated Private Receipt Import
summary: Opt-in authenticated origin binds an exact saved receipt to its owner and task, never all claims using a producer name. Core independently assesses expiry, inputs, scope and result.
permission: Optional principal.receipt_producer boolean defaults to false, including administrators. Existing project authorization and private owner filtering still apply. Producer must equal the authenticated principal ID. Config reload currently requires restart; disabling the permission removes trust on subsequent evaluations without rewriting saved origins.

route.receipts: 1..32 exact complete receipt objects already saved in the active checkpoint; same owner and fixed root/profile/profile_config_hash/task_id/thread_id binding. No unknown fields, duplicate receipts or caller-supplied origin policy.
route.response: Existing shin.task-checkpoint.v1 metadata plus replayed. A new import advances the global slot revision; canonical checkpoint bytes, ID, captured_at and source provenance remain unchanged.

workflow: Save a native draft using the existing private checkpoint endpoint; all embedded receipts begin untrusted.
An explicitly authorized producer confirms a selected subset with full exact receipt objects, the returned revision and a fresh bounded mutation identity.
On uncertain response retry the identical body before its deadline; after expiry inspect metadata and reconcile before another mutation.
Resume or Impact evaluates confirmed and unconfirmed records together. Ordinary save, even with identical receipt bodies, clears all origins. Explicit clear also clears origins.

storage.origins: Server-owned receipt_origins JSONB stores at most32 sorted unique lowercase SHA256 digests of canonical receipt JSON. Each origin must resolve to a saved owner/scope-matching receipt; malformed, duplicate or orphan origins fail database-corrupt.
storage.atomicity: Import validates under the existing checkpoint mutation lock and row CAS. Exact-body hashing is bounded; no filesystem access occurs during import. Existing replay deadlines, retirement floor and clear/prune fences apply. Only the latest mutation has a replay record.
storage.projection: Origin digests and canonical checkpoint text never appear in public metadata. Assessment reports server-authenticated-receipt-origin or server-no-active-receipt-origin.
storage.migration: 018 adds empty origins to existing017 rows and allows receipt-import as a mutation operation. Historical017 migration bytes are unchanged. No existing claim becomes trusted by upgrading.

nativeBoundary.policy: SessionEvaluationOptions.trusted_receipt_documents is a host-only exact canonical-record set, bounded at32 records and256KiB. Client draft/checkpoint JSON and the public CLI cannot populate it. The existing explicit CLI trusted_producers contract is unchanged.
nativeBoundary.assessment: Origin does not bypass TTL, current fixed scope, input coverage/completeness, observed source drift or check result. Existing declared-complete narrow input scope remains available; snapshot/worktree mismatch alone is not generalized into unconditional invalidity.
nativeBoundary.proof: Server authenticates the presenter, not command execution. command_independently_verified and continuous_execution_attestation remain false. No signing service, cross-owner delegation, test execution, background import or shared project authority.
